title: Structurally manipulated antioxidant peptides derived from wheat bran: Preparation and identification.
authors: Zhuang, Min; Li, Jiaqing; Wang, Anqi; Li, Gaoheng; Ke, Sheng; Wang, Xuanyu; Ning, Ming; Sheng, Zhanwu; Wang, Bing; Zhou, Zhongkai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究麦麸抗氧化肽的制备及其与Keap1蛋白的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-肽互作模拟，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法创新，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究无关。
abstract: Bioactive peptide's development is facing two challenges in terms of its lower yield and limited understanding of structurally orientated functionality. Therefore, peptides were prepared from wheat bran via a cocktail enzyme for achieving a higher level of hydrophobic amino acids than traditional method. The obtained peptides exhibited great antioxidant activities against H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress in HepG2 cells. Among them, 91 bioactive peptides were selected through the virtual screening, and their N-terminal and C-terminal contained many hydrophobic amino acids. Then the peptides with capacity to interact with Keap1 were identified by in silico simulation, because Keap1 acts as a sensor of redox insults. The results revealed that peptides DLDW and DLGL demonstrated the highest binding affinities, and a bridge was formed between Asp of DLGL and Arg415 of Klech domain, contributing to interfering Keap1-Nrf2 interaction. These findings implied a potential application of wheat bran peptides as nutraceuticals and health-promoting ingredients.
abstract_zh: 生物活性肽的开发正面临两个挑战：其产率较低以及对结构导向功能性的理解有限。因此，通过鸡尾酒酶从麦麸中制备肽，以实现比传统方法更高水平的疏水性氨基酸。所得肽在HepG2细胞中对H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激表现出优异的抗氧化活性。其中，通过虚拟筛选选出了91种生物活性肽，其N端和C端含有许多疏水性氨基酸。随后，通过计算机模拟识别出具有与Keap1相互作用能力的肽，因为Keap1作为氧化还原损伤的传感器。结果表明，肽DLDW和DLGL表现出最高的结合亲和力，并在DLGL的天冬氨酸与Klech结构域的精氨酸415之间形成桥接，有助于干扰Keap1-Nrf2相互作用。这些发现暗示了麦麸肽作为营养保健品和促进健康成分的潜在应用。
